summary: Two churches, Sacred Heart and St. Isidore the Farmer; both bulletins read (Nov 8 and 15) print the same schedule box, which the website matches. Weekday Masses Tue-Wed and the first-Sunday Spanish Mass are at the Sacred Heart High School Chapel, not on the church list, so excluded (R23). Open: Tue/Wed confession location, and how to record the overnight Thursday-Friday Adoration.
